data.name: XV
data.detailed_description:
THIS GAME IS STILL IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT AND IS A STUDENT RUN FAN PROJECT. SCREENSHOTS SEEN ON THE PAGE ARE NOT INDICATIVE OF THE FINAL PRODUCT

XV tells the story of the destruction of earth, the departure of the rich, the attempted colonization of Venus, and a journey through the depths of Hell, all wrapped up in a crunchy 90's shooter inspired bow! Follow the narrative of King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard's 15th studio album, Infest the Rat's nest, fight your way through cultists and demons to enact your revenge on the rich who ruined your planet. 

Based on Boomer shooters of yore, like Doom, Quake, and even modern releases such as David Szymanski's Dusk. Play as a survivor on earth who has to shoot their way through waves of cult members. Pick up health and ammo packs to survive and continue your mission to escape earth. Kill everything in your path before it can kill you.

More content to be released in the future!

data.short_description: The operation has begun. Mars has been colonized, the earth is no longer habitable, your only choice is Venus. Follow the story of King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard's 15th studio Album Infest the Rats Nest and journey straight to Hell! Fighting off demons and cultists in this 90's inspired shooter.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features heavy violence. The player can shoot and kill other humans which may be distressing for some. Along with getting shot, enemies will spray blood on the player.
